evidence.detail: edit_archetypes() calls load_archetypes(order_by='a.name') with no season_id, causing all-season aggregation
load_archetypes() with season_id=None uses season_query returning 'TRUE', aggregating stats across all seasons
EditArchetypes also calls deck.load_queue_similarity and rule.apply_rules_to_decks on every page load

triage.notes: Most likely culprit is load_archetypes with no season filter aggregating across all historical seasons. A fix might restrict to current season or cache the archetype list, but needs DB profiling to confirm. Could also be apply_rules_to_decks. Scope unclear without measurements.
